title: poa palustris var. strictula
intro: Poa palustris var. strictula, commonly known as strict alpine bluegrass, is a variety of grass species within the Poa genus. It is a type of plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Poa palustris var. strictula include various compounds such as alkaloids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties. While limited research is available, Poa palustris var. strictula is often used to support respiratory health and has been traditionally used to treat conditions such as bronchitis and coughs.
